subject: Problems creating a ZIP in shiny app

messages.author: 0da2677f4d47b6a2
messages.subject: Problems creating a ZIP in shiny app
parts:
Hi everyone!

I'm trying to download the results got with my shiny app. I'm using the following code:

#In the server.R:

output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = paste0( "Resultados-", Sys.Date(), '.zip') ,
    content = function( file ) {
      zip( file,"./OUT" )
    }
    ,contentType = "application/zip"
  )
 
# In the ui.R

tabPanel( "Resultados",
               h4( "Resultados" ),                 
               verbatimTextOutput( "summary" ),
               h4( "Gráfico" ),
               plotOutput( "mpgPlot" ),
               downloadButton( 'downloadData', ' Descargar resultados en un fichero zip' ),
               br(),
               HTML( '<br> <strong>En Linux:</strong> Desempaqueta el fichero tar con <i>tar -xvf tufichero.tar</i> <br>
              <strong>En Windows:</strong> Puedes emplear WinZip, <a href="http://www.7-zip.org/"target="_blank" class="bar">7-zip</a> o cualquier otro programa')
               ,br()
              
              
      ),

However, when compiling the app I get:

zip warning: name not matched: ./OUT

zip error: Nothing to do! (try: zip -r9X /tmp/RtmpgTiW6S/file9af61e1814e.zip . -i ./OUT)
